Prompt Your task is to classify the Argument into one of the following argument schemes, given its Debate question, according to Walton's taxonomy. The input is given in the form: [Argument]: argument. [Debate]: debate question. You need to give an answer for the [Scheme] slot. There are four schemes that you can choose to fill it and only these: argument from example, argument from cause to effect, argument from expert opinion
